second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 14 + Average 6 + Difficulty 8 = 28), pdf 50; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-28 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-4, II 5-11, III 12-15, IV 16-20, V 21, VI 22, VII 23-26, VIII 27, 28 project). BLUE PRINT 14/6/8 = 28 = audited count. Answer side prints keys 1-3 (letters) and 4-20 that answer another question set (analysis file); 21-28 unkeyed. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 28.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 50 (heading, LO 15, BLUE PRINT, q1-2) 51 (q3-13) 52 (q14-21) 53 (q22-27) 54 (q27 pictures A-E, q28). A side 'LESSON 13 / Key Answers:' pdf 114-115 (keys 1-20; 'Sample Answers: 14' follows on pdf 115). Folios = pdf page.

KEY SIDE (analysis file evs-3-13_key-side_analysis.md): only keys 1-2 (and by number 3) address their printed questions. Keys 4-20 belong to a different question set — schema v7 'key belongs to another paper version': pair only matching keys, the others empty + flag with the content pointer as 'suggested'. Content fits for the coordinator: key 7 -> q12, key 11 -> q23, keys 14-15 -> q26 (partial), keys 16-20 -> q27 pictures A-E.

Sections: s1 I q1-4 four unlettered bracket options -> mcq (option ids A-D by printed order; keys print letters only '1) B)'); s2 II match q5-11 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III situations q12-15 (vsa); s4 IV T/F q16-20; s5 V q21 (five sub-pairs a-e, part of the question); s6 VI q22 (six sub-items); s7 VII q23-26 (sa); s8 VIII q27 (five pictures -> stimulus st-evs-3-13-q27 with 5 crops, D4 path images/evs-3-13/stimuli/); s9 q28 project work (la).

MARKS (R-E9, control rev 3): s1 '4*1=4' -> 1; s2 '7*1=7' -> 1; s3 '(4 × 1 = 4)' -> 1; s4 '(5 × 1 = 5)' -> 1; s7 '(4 × 2 = 8)' -> 2; null where N disagrees: s5 '(5 × 1 = 5)' over 1 q, s6 '(½ × 6 = 3)' over 1 q (and not integer), s8 '5*1=5' over 1 q, s9 q28: '(5 Marks)' printed on the question itself -> marks 5 (control rev 4: a per-question printed value beats the header); marks_source 'section_header' because MARKS_SOURCE (gate 2.20) has no value naming a per-question printed mark — as printed on the question, not the section's '5*1=5'.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 28 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 15, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

PARKED (R-E8): the empty answers of the 7 match rows (q5-q11) and 5 true/false items (q16-q20) cannot be encoded under gate 2.20 (T-E1, extended to match at control rev 3). Built file kept in the work dir with its stimulus crops; not committed.
